Eligible candidates may apply online through the official recruitment portal by 03/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Researcher
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Research & Development Office at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar under the Department of Materials Engineering. The appointment is temporary for a duration of 12 months.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Researcher position. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following eligibility criteria: Essential Qualification: Ph.D. or equivalent. The percentage or grade points regarding academic qualifications must be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, along with 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Desirable Qualification: The candidate should have hands-on experience in: CFD softwares such as ANSYS, OpenFOAM or Comsol Friction stir based processes Fortran or Python programming Literature review, experimental planning, data analysis and paper writing

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration ranging between INR 72,000/- and 84,000/-. House Rent Allowance (HRA) is NA. The duration of the appointment is 12 months.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: The candidate will work on development of a numerical model for simulation of the Solid Stir Extrusion process. A physics-based modeling framework will be developed capable of predicting material flow, temperature evolution, deformation characteristics, and resulting grain structure. The candidate will be expected to develop FORTRAN based code, and use CFD fundamentals to develop such model. Knowledge of the friction stir based process, CFD basics, deformation and recrystallization fundamentals would be useful.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Researcher
content_sections.text: Access the official application portal using the link provided in the important links section. Submit the required application details before the final deadline of 03/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee the shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights, not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill up a position through this round of selection process without assigning any reason.
